mapper.sql: select id, agreement_type, version, title, content, effective_time, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from wl_agreement
mapper.select: where agreement_type = #{agreementType} and status = '1' and effective_time <= now() and del_flag = '0' order by effective_time desc, id desc limit 1
where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' for update
mapper.insert: insert into wl_agreement(agreement_type, version, title, content, effective_time, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) values(#{agreementType}, #{version}, #{title}, #{content}, #{effectiveTime}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), '', now(), '0')
mapper.update: update wl_agreement set agreement_type = #{agreementType}, version = #{version}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, effective_time = #{effectiveTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
update wl_agreement set status = '2', update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where agreement_type = #{agreementType} and id != #{excludeId} and status = '1' and del_flag = '0'
update wl_agreement set status = '1', update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
